description: This file defines the CarService class, a Spring service component that provides business logic for handling Car entities, including operations like find, add, remove, and update. It interacts with the CarDao for database access.

classes.name: CarService
classes.description: A Spring service class managing Car entities, facilitating CRUD operations via the CarDao.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Retrieves a Car by its ID, throwing an exception if the ID is invalid.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a Car by its ID, verifying the ID before calling the DAO method.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Returns a list of all Cars as a list of maps, or null if none exist.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new Car entity after validating it is not null.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing Car identified by ID with the provided Car object, after validation.
